title: Smoky Basque Tofu
description: A flavorful and smoky tofu dish inspired by the cuisine of Basque region, with a French twist.
instructions: Cut the French baguette into 1-inch slices.
Brush both sides of the baguette slices with olive oil.
Season the tofu with smoky paprika and salt.
Place the tofu on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the tofu for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a small saucepan, heat the minced garlic over low heat.
Simmer the garlic for 5-7 minutes, or until fragrant.
To assemble the dish, place a toasted baguette slice on a plate.
Top with a slice of tofu, a spoonful of garlic sauce, and crushed eclair cookies.
Repeat the layers one more time, finishing with a baguette slice on top.
